title: Temporary moratoria on enrolling high-risk Medicaid service providers — July 2026 updates
supports: DHS states CMS approved an extension of the temporary enrollment moratorium for providers of 12 of Minnesota's 14 high-risk services from 2026-07-27 through 2027-01-27.
DHS states the separate EIDBI enrollment moratorium remains through 2026-10-31.
DHS states HSS ended on 2025-10-31 and new HSS provider enrollment stopped.
DHS separately extended the NEMT enrollment moratorium in the seven-county Twin Cities metro through 2027-01-27; NEMT providers outside those counties may still enroll.
does_not_support: An enrollment moratorium is a control action, not a finding that all existing providers are fraudulent.
The 12-service extension and the seven-county NEMT rule use different scopes and should not be conflated.
